reviewNotes: HOLD - Benadir University's official Faculty of Medicine and Surgery pages identify a five-year MBChB programme, describe basic-science and clinical/clerkship components, publish admission requirements and distinguish local/international fee sections. The university's home page has current July 2026 institutional news, and WDOMS lists the medical school as currently operational. However, the faculty pages contain conflicting five-year and six-year narrative references, and no current itemised international fee, internship terms, clinical-site list, visa/support route or target-market professional eligibility has been verified. Hold until those facts are reconciled from primary sources.
